## What do you want automated or changed

Describe the outcome you want (e.g. "auto-inactivate a contact when they
leave a school" or "also heal county/district fields from WIAA").

## Why

What's the manual work or gap this replaces? Concrete example if possible
(a specific school/contact this would have helped with).

## Scope

- Does this apply to all schools, or a specific rep/state (WI/IL)?
- Should it run automatically on the nightly, or as an on-demand manual
  workflow?
- Any data it should explicitly NOT touch (e.g. district billing
  addresses, locked schools)?
